# Roleplay Rule 10 - Stay in your lane. This means that you should do the job you signed up for and not try to do other people’s jobs for them or lay claim to their department. If you need something from another player you should attempt to ask them to get it for you instead of just taking it. Straying from your lane at the expense of another player should only be done where strictly necessary.
MRP additions and examples of expected RP:
- Asking before taking - if you're entering med, cargo or other departments. You should be asking first. - When you enter medical, you should give the doctors time to see you before you decide to self-heal, stop being cringe. CMO should be delegating - recommend 1 doc per 1 body. (Exceptions may apply) - Command members should be making an active effort to communicate and inform their departments. Don't choose command if you aren't going to do this - Security should make use of their masks to stop a person in the hall, this means they don't need to stop and text, it's the reason the masks exist. This allows for better flow and easier to tell if a person is running vs just being mindless (HOS Should enforce this) -Cargo should make an active effort to transport resources to other departments silos.
## Precedents
- This rule is rooted in the experience of the players behind the characters you will interact with, remember this when playing and avoid justifying stamping on other’s experiences for personal gain. - The total absence of someone working the job which you require is always a legitimate reason to stray from your lane. Players simply being busy or unwilling to assist is not, however. - Where possible players straying from their lane should hand off their assumed responsibilities if another player becomes available to do it instead (if for example a missing roboticist returns to the lab after being revived while a paramedic is trying to handle a cyborg related issue) - Players are free to seek alternate routes that do not impinge on the games of other players to obtain the things they want where normal routes are closed to them. (An assistant that wishes to help a cyborg get upgrades while a roboticist is busy making mechs for security or augmenting patients may freely make use of a maintenance robotics bay, for example) - It is highly encouraged to help the department in which you need something from if it’s apparent that they are new or very understaffed, we overall encourage players to help others if new. This should not be met with admin disapproval and may be rewarded - Familiar’s are to listen to and follow their master. You can ask your master to allow you to leave or do your own thing but don’t do this yourself.
